comparison.objective: Reorient stack-nest totes so they stack on a full tote rather than nesting into its contents.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize tote orientation, grasp a bulky container, rotate it, and place it in the stacking orientation.
comparison.success_condition: Each tote must end stably stacked in the required orientation without nesting onto or disturbing the protected contents.
comparison.reason: Bulk tote reorientation and stacking do not exercise coaxial mandrel placement, controlled hammer impulse, notch fracture, or millimetre-scale fragment recovery.
